name: Springhope Farm
description: Springhope Farm is a pumpkin patch in 18720 Cleveland Avenue, MI. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
